content: Bɑ Dɑfidiɡibu sekuru doke
Yenibɑ kpuron biru, Amɔnibɑn sunɔ u kpunɑ u ɡu, mɑ win bii Hɑnuni u ɡɔnɑ kɔsire kuɑ.
Yerɑ Dɑfidi u nɛɛ, kon Hɑnuni durom kuɑwɑ nɡe mɛ win tundo Nɑkɑsi u rɑɑ mɑn kuɑ. Mɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu ɡɔrɑ bu dɑ bu kɑ nùn nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ win tundon ɡɔɔn sɔ̃. Ye bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ turɑ mi,
yerɑ Hɑnunin sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ tɑmɑɑ Dɑfidin bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ nɑwɑ bu kɑ wunɛn tundo bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃? A ǹ yɛ̃ bɑ nɑwɑ bu kɑ bɛsɛn wuun sɑriɑ ɡiɑ, kpɑ bu ɡu wɔrimɑ bu mwɑ?
Yerɑ Hɑnuni u Dɑfidin bwɑ̃ɑ be mwɛɛrɑ, u ben tobunu kɔnɑ beri berikɑ u sukum deri. Mɑ u ben yɑbenu bɔtirɑ ben tɑɑnun deedeerun di. Yen biru u bu ɡirɑ bɑ doonɑ.
Yerɑ ɡɑbɑ dɑ bɑ ye Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Mɑ u tɔmbu seeyɑ bu nɑ bu bu sennɔ ko kpɑ bu bu sɔ̃ bu ɡinɑ sinɔ Yerikoɔ sere ben tobunu nù n kpiɑ. Domi bɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ seku bɑkɑru sɔɔ.
Dɑfidi u Siriɡibu kɑ Amɔnibɑ kɑmiɑ

Ye Amɔnibɑ bɑ wɑ mɑ Dɑfidin wɛ̃rɑ woo duɑ ben sɔ̃, yerɑ bɑ tɑbu durɔbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu (20.000) kɑnɑ Siriɡibun min di. Tɑbu kowo ben wusɑ, Bɛti Rehɔbu kɑ Sobɑ. Mɑ bɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu (1.000) wɑ Mɑɑkɑn sinɑ bokon min di. Sobɑɡibun min di mɑɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (12.000).
Ye Dɑfidi u nuɑ mɛsum, yerɑ u bu Yoɑbu kɑ win tɑbu durɔbu sure bɑ bu wɔri.
Mɑ Amɔni be, bɑ yɑrɑ bɑ ben tɑbu sĩɑ kpĩ ben wuun ɡbɑ̃rɑrun kɔnnɔwɔ. Adɑmɑ Siriɡii be bɑ nɑ Sobɑ kɑ Bɛti Rehɔbun di, kɑ Tobuɡibu kɑ Mɑɑkɑɡibu, bɑ dɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛnɛm yɑkɑsɔ.
Ye Yoɑbu u wɑ mɑ bɑ koo bu wɔrimɑwɑ biru kɑ wuswɑɑn di, yerɑ u tɑbu yɛ̃robu ɡɔsɑ Isirelibɑ sɔɔ, bu kɑ dɑ bu Siriɡibu wɔri.
Be bɑ mɑɑ tie u nɛɛ win wɔnɔ Abisɑi u bu kpɑro, bu kɑ dɑ bu Amɔnibɑ wɔri.
U win wɔnɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Siriɡibu bɑ̀ n mɑn dɑm kerɑ, ɑ nɑ ɑ mɑn somi. Amɔnibɑ bɑ̀ n mɑɑ nun dɑm kerɑ kon nɑ n nun somi.
A de ɑ n wɔruɡɔru mɔ, kpɑ su sɑnnɑ kɑ hɑniɑ bɛsɛn tɔmbu kɑ wuu si Yinni Gusunɔ u sun wɛ̃n sɔ̃, kpɑ win tii u sun kuɑ nɡe mɛ u kĩ.
Yoɑbu kɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɑ bu kɑ Siriɡii be wɔri, mɑ Siriɡii be, bɑ duki yɑkikirɑ.
Ye Amɔnibɑ bɑ wɑ mɑ Siriɡibu bɑ duki yɑkikirɑ, yerɑ ben tii bɑ mɑɑ yɑkikirɑ Abisɑin wuswɑɑn di, bɑ wɔri wuuɔ. Yen biru Yoɑbu u ɡɔsirɑ u wurɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Ye Siriɡii be, bɑ wɑ mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ bu kɑmiɑwɑ, yerɑ bɑ wure bɑ mɑɑ ben tɑbu kowobu mɛnnɑ.
Mɑ Hɑdɑdesɛɛ u ɡɔrɑ bu Siriɡii be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑtin ɡuruɔ sokumɑ. Yerɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ nɑ Helɑmuɔ. Sobɑki Hɑdɑdesɛɛn tɑbu sunɔwɑ u bu kpɑre.
Yerɑ bɑ Dɑfidi ye sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Mɑ u Isirelibɑ mɛnnɑ, bɑ Yuudɛni tɔburɑ bɑ nɑ Helɑmuɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Siriɡibu bɑ sɔɔru kuɑ bɑ Isirelibɑ wɔri bɑ kɑ bu tɑbu kuɑ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ bu kpɑnɑ bɑ duki suɑ. Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ ben tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu (700) ɡo be bɑ tɑbu kɛkɛbɑ kpɑre sɔɔ, kɑ mɑɑsɔbu nɔrɔbun subɑ weeru (40.000). Mɑ bɑ ben tɑbu sunɔ Sobɑki mɛɛrɑ kuɑ. Miyɑ u ɡu.
Sinɑm be bɑ rɑɑ Hɑdɑdesɛɛ sɑ̃ɑmɔ mi, bɑ wɑ mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ nùn kɑmiɑ. Yerɑ bɑ kɑ Isireli be dorɑ mɑ bɑ Dɑfidi sɑ̃wɑ. Sɑɑ yen dɔmɑ ten di, Siriɡibu bɑ ǹ mɑɑ wure bu Amɔnibɑ somiru dɑ.
